name: Basic Cookie Dough
description: A versatile base biscuit dough — the starting point for jam drops, choc chip, ginger, cornflake cookies, and more.

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 180°C. Line baking trays with baking paper.
Cream together the butter and caster sugar until light and fluffy.
Add the egg and vanilla extract and beat well.
Gradually add the self-raising flour and mix until you have a stiff paste.
Roll the dough into balls and place on the lined trays.

notes: Adapted from https://cookerandalooker.com/the-only-cookie-recipe-youll-ever-need/. Variations from the source: jam drops (hollow each ball and fill with jam before baking); chocolate cookies (add 1/2 cup brown sugar when creaming and 1/2 cup cocoa with the flour); smarties (press into tops before baking); coconut (add 2 tbsp desiccated coconut to the dough); chocolate chip (add 100g chocolate chips); cornflake (add 1/2 cup sultanas and 3/4 cup crushed cornflakes).
